text:
sara-partners: FYI CloudPartnerX wants a public onboarding checklist for marketplace metering + an automatic reconciliation run every 24h. They also want a "late-batch credit" rule so small late arrivals auto-credit pro-rata. cc @leo-finance @andrew-platform @nina-sec

leo-finance: We can do auto-credit for late arrivals but need clear thresholds and audit trail. Finance requires: 1) percent_threshold_for_auto_credit, 2) max_credit_per_day_usd, 3) ledger_entry_reason_code. Anything automated must be reversible via dispute flow.

andrew-platform: Implementation notes: ingestion connector must normalize timestamps to UTC, emit both partner_raw_value and normalized_value, and include a sample_confidence flag when partner sampling is used. If partner sends sampled counts we need sampling_rate to upscale.

nina-sec: Security/governance: webhook MUST include HMAC-Signature header and a cert thumbprint in onboarding doc. partner_customer_id should be hashed; store mapping in vault-only table. Also need SLA for retention of raw payloads (default 180 days).

qa-solutions: For reconciliation tests we need a 72-hour sample with: raw webhooks, expected normalized CSV, and a small set of dispute cases (duplicate, late-arrival, sampling-mismatch). We'll run a dry-run reconciliation job that outputs diffs and suggested credits.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: partner-recon-dryrun-cloudpartnerx -> runs 2026-03-15T07:00:00Z (one-time).

andrew-platform: Draft mapping schema (proposal):
```yaml
partner: cloudpartnerx
metering:
  metrics:
    - name: gpu_seconds
      partner_key: compute_seconds
      normalize_to: inference_seconds
      multiplier: 1.25 # partner reports raw GPU sec; conversion to billing sec
      sampling_rate: 1 # 1 = full, >1 = sampling denominator
      aggregation: hourly
      dedup_keys: [batch_id,event_id]
      partial_credit_rules:
        - late_window_sec: 86400 # 24h
          credit_pct: 50
        - late_window_sec: 604800 # 7d
          credit_pct: 10
      auto_credit_threshold_pct: 3
    - name: api_calls
      partner_key: op_count
      normalize_to: requests
      multiplier: 1.0
      sampling_rate: 1
      aggregation: per_call
      dedup_keys: [event_id]
  liability_policy:
    owner: partner
    dispute_escalation_days: 14
    max_daily_auto_credit_usd: 5000
```

leo-finance: This looks good. Add ledger fields: ledger_table = partner_raw_ledger, ledger_retention_days = 180, ledger_audit_tags = [partner_id, batch_id, reconcile_run_id]. Finance wants a CSV output per run with adjustments column.

sara-partners: I'll send the checklist + sample mapping to CloudPartnerX and request the 72-hour payload by Monday. Also will include the HMAC sample header format.

andrew-platform: We should also expose a partner-status endpoint that reports last_ingested_ts, last_recon_run, pending_disputes_count. I'll open a short PR for the connector today.

nina-sec: Onboarding checklist items I'll send: cert thumbprint, HMAC secret exchange channel, hashed_customer_mapping process, required retention, and SOC2 notes.

qa-solutions: For the dry-run we'll validate: 1) dedup works when partner replays with same batch_id, 2) sampling upscale math, 3) partial_credit applied correctly. I'll book time with engineering to run tests.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: run partner-mapping-health-check on 2026-03-16 09:00 UTC.

leo-finance: Action items summary:
- @andrew-platform: PR for connector + partner-status endpoint (ETA: Wed)
- @sara-partners: request 72h sample + onboarding checklist (ETA: Mon)
- @nina-sec: send security onboarding doc (ETA: Tue)
- @qa-solutions: prepare dry-run test plan and expected CSV schema (ETA: Wed)

sara-partners: Thanks all, I'll track in the partnership board and move to solutions handoff when we pass dry-run. :thumbsup:
